content.title: Losses Deepen at PAMT (PAMT), Challenging Value Narrative Despite Low Price-to-Sales Ratio
content.summary: PAMT (PAMT) remains in the red, with losses expanding at an annual rate of 39.5% over the past five years and no sign of improvement in net profit margin last year. Investors are watching closely as the company’s growing losses and weak financial footing are set against a notably low Price-To-Sales Ratio of 0.4x. This stands out compared to the US transportation industry average of 1.3x and peers at 0.6x. See our full analysis for Pamt. Now, we’ll see how this latest set of numbers holds up...
